summary: AIB Data Centers Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing two interdependent, concurrently closing agreements signed September 4, 2026, to acquire about 29.385 Texas acres for a data center campus. The PSA buys 5.00 acres (Property A) for $8,250,000 cash, already served by 15 MW of primary electric. The MIPA buys 100% of a Delaware LLC holding rights to 24.385 adjacent acres (Property B) for $8,975,400, with $2,975,400 at closing and a $6,000,000 deferred payment due when utility facilities enter service, secured by a JPMorgan letter of credit. Aggregate consideration is roughly $17,225,400; no board recommendation or advisor is named. Deadline for the deferred-payment release is December 31, 2028, after which a parent guaranty may substitute. Watch power-delivery timing and the associated debt obligation as the key execution risks.
